licensing_agencies.scope: Statewide licensing/registration of day care centers, school-age, family and group family day care. Excludes NYC day care centers.

discovery.authoritative_registry: OCFS Child Care Regulated Programs (data.ny.gov fymg-3wv3); NYC Active Child Care Programs (data.cityofnewyork.us gy3q-4tzp)
discovery.public_api: Socrata SODA on data.ny.gov and data.cityofnewyork.us
discovery.inspection_sources: NYC: DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections (Historical), frozen April 2023. Statewide OCFS inspections are portal-only on each provider profile.
discovery.complaint_enforcement_policy: OCFS publishes inspection findings and enforcement on provider profiles; NYC DOHMH publishes inspection summaries on the Child Care Connect portal.
discovery.stable_identifiers: OCFS facility_id; NYC DCID (DCxxxxx) and permit number; NYC BIN/BBL for buildings.
discovery.update_frequency: OCFS nightly; NYC active programs roughly weekly to daily.
discovery.bulk_harvesting: Yes — full pulls are small (about 3k and 17k rows).
discovery.unavailable_fields: Current (post-2023) NYC inspection details; OCFS inspection history; operator legal entity on NYC active feed.

notes: Pilot state. Reference facility: Bright Horizons at DUMBO (DC37595).

candidates.description:
